claims.text: NCEL outperforms all baseline methods in both easy and hard cases, indicating its overall effectiveness.
NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases on the GERBIL benchmark, with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1.
The method shows consistent performance across five different benchmarks, verifying its generalization ability.
